title: Answered (a-graph-2)
summary: incident.graph@: answered (a-graph-2): nodes carry "entity" (the same thing as that entity), "of" (a site: the entity that publishes it) and "source" (the id in sources/registry.json), each stated by us, in meteorology/nodes/<type>.json and in graph.json; the join by host can become a fact where one is present
closes: The one it waits on answers, and the asking agent's status file no longer lists it.
